# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.2.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.2   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please open a [GitHub Security Advisory](https://github.com/magitech-ai/nicegui-ai/security/advisories/new) or email maintainers at security@magitech-ai.ai.

We will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and provide an initial assessment within 5 business days. If the report is confirmed, we will:

1. Prepare a fix and publish a new release.
2. Credit the reporter in the release notes (unless they prefer to remain anonymous).
3. Notify affected users via the release and Dependabot alerts.

## Disclosure Policy

We follow coordinated disclosure: please do not publicly disclose the vulnerability until we have released a fix and notified users.
